title: Mandatory declarations grouped together on one panel
plain: The declarations are together, on one panel
plain_action: Check whether the mandatory declarations are grouped on a single face, and photograph the whole of that face.

citation.text: Panel screening only. The PDP may include pre-printed information in one place and on-line information in another; physical panel differences alone do not establish an offence.

messages.pass: The mandatory declarations are grouped on a single panel.
messages.violation: The mandatory declarations are scattered across different panels rather than grouped together at one place as Rule 7 requires.
messages.inconclusive: Panel assignment requires review: pre-printed and on-line declarations may occupy separate places.

sources.review_status: primary source reviewed; screening paraphrase; incomplete consolidation
